descriptors.R: nominee of the party that won control of the House of Representatives in 2010; a former governor of a New England state and business executive
descriptors.D: the sitting President, nominee of the party that has held the White House since 2009

compile_desc.R: the party that won control of the House of Representatives in 2010
compile_desc.D: the party that has held the White House since 2009

others_line: Other candidates on most ballots, including a Libertarian and a Green nominee (answer "other").
never_name: Romney, Obama, Ryan, Biden, Bush, Clinton, Gingrich, Santorum, Ron Paul, Gary Johnson or Stein

slice_sources.men: 2012 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) aged to November 2012; men who are citizens 18+ (the native_white, naturalized, black and other slots) less those barred for a felony conviction (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2012 (interpolated between their 2010 and 2016 estimates)); outside the eleven former Confederate states; turnout and choice calibrated to the certified 2012 returns.
slice_sources.women: 2012 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) aged to November 2012; women who are citizens 18+ (the native_white, naturalized, black and other slots) less those barred for a felony conviction (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2012 (interpolated between their 2010 and 2016 estimates)); outside the eleven former Confederate states; turnout and choice calibrated to the certified 2012 returns.
slice_sources.south-white: 2012 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) aged to November 2012; white non-Hispanic adults in the eleven former Confederate states (US-born in the native_white slot; white naturalized citizens sit in the naturalized slot), less felony disenfranchisement (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2012 (interpolated between their 2010 and 2016 estimates)); calibrated to the certified 2012 returns.
slice_sources.black-south: 2012 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) aged to November 2012; US-born Black adults in the eleven former Confederate states, all citizens with no legal bar beyond felony disenfranchisement (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2012 (interpolated between their 2010 and 2016 estimates)), which falls on them disproportionately; calibrated to the certified 2012 returns.
slice_sources.immigrants: 2012 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) aged to November 2012; noncitizen adults (the alien slot), who cannot vote in federal elections; naturalized citizens are counted in the naturalized slot and can vote.

masks: the nominee of the party out of the White House
